jobs.description:
At Sumary, we are rebuilding finance from first principles. In short, we are creating the AI operating system for accounting work. Founded in 2025, Sumary is already used by some of the largest accounting firms in the world, including Deloitte, Grant Thornton and Baker Tilly, and the products we ship will define how finance teams work in the coming decade.

We have raised $29m, including the largest seed round ever in the Nordics, from Singular, byFounders, Partech and Tenity, and angels including Tuomas Artman (Linear), Morten Primdahl (Zendesk), Steve Anavi (Qonto), Stanislas Polu (Dust), Steffen Tjerrild (Synthesia), Jannick Malling (Public) and Ben Freeman (Omnea).

Our engineers are also our product managers and designers. You talk to customers, understand their pain points, design the best solution and ship it to a standard that sets the bar for the industry. You are confident owning features end to end, from the data model to the last pixel of the interface.

AI writes most of our code, so producing code is no longer the bottleneck. Judgment is: deciding what is worth building, and making it excellent. Just because something takes half a day to build doesn't mean it should exist.

We are a small team of full-stack generalists, TypeScript end to end, and product comes first in everything we build. What unites us is a deep care for craft, fast execution and the discipline to say no. We are looking for experienced engineers who thrive on autonomy and individual responsibility.

We have offices in Copenhagen and London. Copenhagen is our engineering hub, and this role is based there.

**Come help define and build the future of finance.

**What you'll do

• Work closely with founders and customers, and turn what you hear into the right solution, which is often not the one they asked for

• Build new user-facing features end to end, with beautiful and scalable UI components

• Obsessively improve performance, so every interaction feels instant, even for our largest accounting firms

• Use what you built the way a customer would, and polish it until it is right before it ships

• Delete by default: push back on scope, on features we shouldn't build and on anything that feels off

• When an agent gets something wrong, fix the tooling so it doesn't happen again for anyone

What we're looking for

• 5+ years building customer-facing products at a company known for the quality of its software

• Deep fluency in TypeScript and React, and confidence across the full stack: Node.js, Postgres and the data model underneath

• Product obsession and a good eye for design: you care about UX, speed and polish. You notice the slow interaction, the awkward empty state and the setting nobody needs, and you fix them without being asked

• A track record of shipping complete features end to end, not only incremental work

• Comfort working without a product manager. You would rather talk to the customer yourself

• High ownership: you take a problem from start to finish and care about how it lands

• You know the difference between extra effort and meaningful quality

• You build AI-first, directing agents through the implementation while you own the judgment

Nice to have

• Experience as one of the first engineers at a startup that went on to scale

• Interfaces you designed yourself, not only built

• Experience with financial and ledger data

Our stack

TypeScript end to end: React and Next.js, Node.js, Postgres and Supabase, Temporal, Modal and our AI service layers. We don't expect you to have used all of it.

Applying

Along with your CV, send us something you built that you are proud of, and one thing in a product you use every day that you would fix.

Strategic Procurement Specialist, IGS to Coop Trading A/S

Coop Trading

Annonce slut: 27.11.2026

Strategic Procurement Specialist – Indirect Goods & Services

Do you find motivation in building value through teamwork, strategic sourcing, and productive supplier partnerships? Would you like to help shape procurement decisions across Nordic retail organizations and contribute to a more efficient and sustainable business? Then keep reading.

As our new Procurement Specialist, Indirect Goods & Services (IGS), you will play an important role in developing category plans, managing sourcing projects, and partnering with colleagues across the Nordic markets to identify opportunities and deliver value.

As a member of our Indirect Goods & Services (IGS) team, you will report to the Head of Procurement, Nonfood and contribute to advancing the IGS agenda throughout the Nordics.

**What you'll be doing

**

In this role, you will:

• Develop and execute category plans and sourcing strategies across assigned indirect goods and services categories

• Deliver cost savings, working capital improvements, and other value-creation initiatives

• Manage end-to-end sourcing projects, including analysis, tender management, supplier selection, negotiation, and implementation

• Negotiate and manage commercial agreements while ensuring compliance with procurement governance and policies

• Build and maintain positive supplier relationships, promoting performance, innovation, and continuous improvement

• Provide strategic procurement support and advisory to internal stakeholders across the Nordic organizations

• Utilize market insights, benchmarking, and data analysis to support decision-making and identify new opportunities

• Support process enhancements and contribute to the continued evolution of procurement tools and best practices

**What we're looking for

**

We know that great candidates do not always meet every requirement, but we imagine that you bring:

• 1-5 years of experience within procurement, strategic sourcing, category management, or a related commercial discipline

• Experience managing supplier relationships and commercial negotiations

• Solid analytical skills and the ability to turn insights into practical recommendations

• Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in a changing business environment

• Knowledge of procurement processes, sourcing methodologies, and contract management

• Experience working with data, Excel, and procurement-related systems

• Interest in IT/AI is an advantage, but not a requirement

• Professional proficiency in English and at least one Nordic language

**Who you are

**

You enjoy working with people and building relationships across different functions and cultures. You combine strategic thinking with a practical approach and are at ease working through both complexity and change.

You are likely someone who:

• Communicates clearly and builds trust with colleagues and partners

• Takes initiative and follows through on commitments

• Collaborates effectively across teams and markets

• Is curious, methodical, and open to new perspectives

• Stays organized while managing multiple priorities

• Approaches challenges with a positive and solution-oriented mindset

• Works well both on your own and as part of a team

• Seeks opportunities to improve processes and ways of working

**What we offer

**

At Coop Trading, you'll be part of an international and collaborative environment where you can help shape decisions and contribute to meaningful business results.

We offer:

• An exciting role with broad exposure across the Nordic markets

• The opportunity to shape sourcing strategies and procurement initiatives

• Collaboration with experienced colleagues and stakeholders across four countries

• Professional and personal development opportunities

• A culture built on trust, teamwork, learning, and continuous improvement

• Flexibility and support for a healthy work-life balance

Workplace: Our office is located at Skelbækgade 2, 1717 Copenhagen V.

We believe that a positive culture is built through spending time together. Our Vesterbro office is therefore our primary place of work, while we offer the flexibility to work from home when needed.

The role includes approximately 20-35 travel days per year, including occasional overnight stays.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Head of Procurement, Nonfood Michael Bjunes at +45 2777 2432.

If you are ready to join Coop Trading's Procurement team, please send us your application and CV no later than 27th of November 2026. We review applications on an on-going basis.

About us:

Coop Trading’s purpose is to make a better every day through leading Nordic private brands for 27 million Nordic consumers delivering the best quality products at a fair price. Our portfolio encompasses both food and daily non-food items within our private brands: Xtra, Coop, and Änglamark.

Coop Trading represents Coop in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, as well as SOK in Finland. Through our private brands, we are proud to be present on every third dinner table in Nordic homes. On behalf of our four partners, we develop products for our private brand portfolio through innovation, product development, and negotiating Nordic agreements.

Coop Trading is a dynamic, responsible, and ambitious workplace. We are 140 dedicated professionals in Denmark and in Spain, as well as a network of trusted partners across the Nordic region. We work to challenge the status quo delivering the best and most innovative private brand products.

A cornerstone of our identity is our continuous commitment to fostering an engaging and appreciative work environment and to being an exceptional place to work.

We want to create equal opportunities for everyone and ensure an efficient and fair recruitment process. It is therefore up to you whether you wish to attach an application letter and a photo.

At Coop Trading, we aim to create an Inclusive and diverse environment, and we actively search for qualified candidates regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, disability or age. You will be part of a diverse and Inclusive company. where we see diversity as a strength.

Coop Trading is developing and sourcing products to make the everyday life better for 27 millon Nordic consumers by leading Nordic private brands: Xtra, Coop, and Anglamark.

jobs.occupation: Power System Engineer for Dynamics, Modelling and Control; DK - Fredericia
jobs.description:
The Danish power system is changing rapidly as wind, solar, batteries, power electronics and international connections play an increasingly important role. This creates new dynamic behaviour and calls for better models, analysis methods and engineering tools. As our new Power System Engineer, you help us understand these changes and turn complex analyses into practical solutions. You also help develop and maintain the simulation environment that supports our stability studies and engineering decisions.

“We are looking for someone who enjoys building models and tools while keeping sight of the physical power-system problem they are intended to solve. A structured approach to maintenance, quality and processes is just as important as developing new solutions.”
– Laurids Dall, Manager

Join an international team of power-system specialists
At our head office in Fredericia you join a highly specialised and international team working with power-system dynamics, stability and power quality. We support system operation, contribute to major technical projects and identify the capabilities the future power system will need. Close technical collaboration is an important part of our work, and we therefore expect you to work from the office at least two days a week.

Shape the tools behind a stable power system and enhance our simulation environment

Your tasks depend on your experience and the projects you join. You will typically:

• Perform dynamic stability studies and identify present and future system needs.
• Develop and validate dynamic models and analysis methods.
• Develop, maintain and quality-assure our simulation environment, primarily using DIgSILENT PowerFactory and PSCAD.
• Automate simulations, screening and analysis workflows.
• Translate technical findings into recommendations for system design and operation.
The job combines power-system engineering with structured development and maintenance. You help ensure that models, processes and results are documented, reproducible and suitable for reuse across the organisation. 

Within your first 6–12 months, we expect you to have:

• Contributed professionally to stability studies or model-development activities.
• Understood the structure and purpose of our simulation environment.
• Improved at least one model, workflow or quality-assurance process.
• Turned analysis results into clear technical conclusions.
• Build effective working relationships within the team and across Energinet.
Combine technical curiosity with a structured approach

You have a MSc in electrical engineering or a related field. Your academic or professional background may include electrical power systems, power-system dynamics, power electronics, converter control or electrical energy systems. You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of relevant experience. We do not expect you to know every part of the field from day one. What matters is your technical foundation, willingness to learn and ability to approach complex engineering problems systematically. 

You check off one or more of the qualifications we are looking for:

• Dynamic modelling and stability analysis in DIgSILENT PowerFactory or PSCAD/EMTDC
• RMS or EMT simulation
• Programming, scripting or automated engineering workflows
• Model validation, documentation and quality assurance
• Version control or collaborative software-development practices
Often the problems we work with do not have a predefined solution. You should therefore enjoy investigating complex technical questions, challenging assumptions and developing new approaches together with others. You will thrive in the role if you:

• Are curious and want to understand why a system behaves as it does.
• Enjoy building models and tools while keeping sight of the problem they are intended to solve.
• Can structure complex problems, turn analysis into practical conclusions and take responsibility for progressing your own work.
• Enjoy collaborating and sharing knowledge with other specialists as well as communicating complex topics to colleagues with different technical backgrounds.
Will you make a difference with us?

We look forward to receiving your motivated CV no later than 20 December. You may want to pencil in a couple of dates in your calendar already. We expect the first interview to take place online on 5 January and the second interview in Fredericia on 11 January.
If you have questions about the job, please contact Manager Laurids Dall on
tel. +45 3092 3194.

Special conditions: As Energinet performs tasks critical to society, we carry out background checks prior to employment. Employment is conditional upon your background check being compatible with employment at Energinet. The background check is also carried out once a year.
The position also requires that you are able to obtain and maintain security clearance. On PET's website, you can read more about security clearance.

We see diversity as a strength and encourage all qualified people, regardless of background, to apply for the job. We work actively and determinedly with diversity in Energinet and therefore encourage you to exclude information about age, marital status, etc. to minimise outage biases in the process. You can read more about our diversity policy here.

Energinet Systemsansvar's core tasks are to integrate renewable energy, ensure equal access to the grids, develop market design, monitor, and balance the transmission grid and ensure security of supply in Denmark. We are a subsidiary of the Energinet Group, which represents the interests of society when supplying Denmark with electricity and gas and that the energy system is converted to green energy. Our culture is closely linked to our social responsibility, and we work actively with the UN's global goals on sustainable energy, climate action, partnerships for action as well as industry, innovation, and infrastructure. By leading the way in the green transition, we can help to solve the global climate challenge. New solutions require us to be able to see problems from many different angles, and diversity is therefore a keyword in our culture. We strive to listen to, involve and share our knowledge. Based on the values of courage and trust, we focus on constantly developing ourselves as an organisation and as people. Read more at our website www.energinet.dk.

Help us build a secure, efficient and user-friendly digital workplace! We are looking for a Microsoft 365 & Modern Workplace Specialist to join our IT Operations & Security team.

As our new Microsoft 365 & Modern Workplace Specialist, you will play a central role in managing, developing, and continuously improving our Microsoft 365 ecosystem and modern workplace platform. Working across Microsoft Intune, Windows endpoint management, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Exchange Online, and Microsoft Entra ID, you will help deliver a secure, efficient, and user-focused digital workplace.

Package, deploy and maintain applications, administer and continuously improve Microsoft Intune.

Manage Windows 11 device configuration and policies.

Do you want to help shape and evolve the foundation that powers data-driven decision-making across Arla?

In Data Foundation, we are responsible for delivering and evolving the core Azure Databricks data platform and infrastructure that enables analytics, reporting and AI solutions across Arla. As an Experienced Data Platform Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the technical direction of the team, mentoring colleagues and ensuring we continue to deliver a modern, enterprise-grade platform that supports the needs of the business, says Senior Manager, Head of IT Product, Thomas Morthorst Overgaard.

**How You Will Make An Impact

**As an Experienced Data Platform Engineer, you will join an international team responsible for developing and maintaining Arla’s Data Foundation Platform. You will contribute to the continuous evolution of our cloud-based data platform, ensuring scalability, reliability and performance across our data ecosystem. Your key responsibilities include:

• Contribute to the technical implementation of complex features and services while improving architecture and reducing technical debt.

• Support other developers through code reviews, technical coaching and knowledge-sharing sessions.

• Collaborate closely with Product Architects and product teams to shape technical direction and non-functional requirements.

• Design and implement robust services, APIs and data pipelines, ensuring scalable and maintainable solutions.

• Drive best practices within code quality, testing, automation and observability.

• Evolve CI/CD pipelines and strengthen platform reliability, performance and resilience.

**To succeed in this role, you combine strong engineering expertise with a passion for platform development, automation and continuous improvement. You enjoy solving complex technical challenges and helping others grow through collaboration and mentoring. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the requirements. We imagine the ideal candidate brings:

• Several years of experience developing and maintaining enterprise-scale data platforms.

• Strong expertise within Azure Databricks, Azure services, Terraform, Python/PySpark and SQL.

• Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure DevOps, GitHub and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

• Understanding of architectural patterns, integration design and modern software engineering practices.

• Experience with CI/CD, test automation and DevOps methodologies.

• Knowledge of observability, performance optimization, resilience patterns and incident management.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, combined with the ability to mentor and guide colleagues.

• Professional proficiency in English.

**What do we offer?

**You will join a highly skilled international team working on one of Arla’s most critical technology platforms. We offer an environment where innovation, knowledge sharing and continuous learning are highly valued, and where you will have the opportunity to influence the future of our enterprise data landscape. At Arla, we are committed to professional development and empowering our people to grow their careers while making a real impact across the business.

**Would you like to join us?

**Please apply as soon as possible, as we review applications on a continuous basis and may close the recruitment once the right candidate has been found.

For additional information, please contact Senior Manager, Thomas Morthorst Overgaard at +45 91 31 14 51.

**Shape the Future of Dairy

**Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

At WS Technicals, Battery Development Engineers turn ideas and requirements into robust, manufacturable lithium battery systems.

This role focuses on mechanical design and development — transforming early concepts into tested, validated, and production-ready solutions.

Battery Development Engineers at WS Technicals combine technical precision with creativity. You’ll work closely with colleagues in electrical, thermal, and production engineering to create durable, efficient, and safe energy systems that perform in demanding environments.

What the Role Involves

The role typically includes, but is not limited to:

• Performing material selection, tolerance analysis, and design-for-manufacturing reviews.

jobs.occupation: Cloud Operations Engineer to join Global IT department at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Cloud Operations Engineer to join Global IT department at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you’re energised by cloud technology and working closely with users to solve their challenges and thrive on learning and finding practical solutions, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a Cloud Operations Engineer to join our dedicated team in Global IT.

As a team, we are responsible for operating and continuously improving our Microsoft Azure environment and the processes surrounding our cloud platform.

This is an early-career role where you will get the opportunity to develop your cloud engineering skills while working with real operational challenges. You will work closely with colleagues, internal users, application teams, and other stakeholders.

A key part of your role will be handling requests and incidents related to our Azure environment, improving operational processes and documentation, and helping ensure that our cloud platform remains structured and easy for our users and teams to work with.

How you might spend your days

As a Cloud Operations Engineer, you’ll be:

• 
Handling and following up on end-user requests and incidents related to our Microsoft Azure environment

• 
Supporting the daily operation of our Azure platform, including troubleshooting cloud infrastructure and platform services

• 
Working with Azure DevOps and supporting deployment, automation, and platform processes

• 
Maintaining and improving operational processes, documentation, and ways of working as the platform evolves

• 
Collaborating with end users, application teams, cloud engineers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and help turn them into practical solutions

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• 
Curious and motivated to learn more about cloud technology and platform engineering

• 
Comfortable working with end users, colleagues and stakeholders with different technical backgrounds

• 
Willing to take ownership of tasks while also asking for help and learning from more experienced colleagues

• 
Interested in improving processes rather than simply following them when there is a better way of working

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• 
Some practical experience with Microsoft Azure, gained through professional work, internships, education & certifications

• 
Familiarity with Azure DevOps or similar tools used for repositories, pipelines, automation, or work management

• 
An interest in cloud operations and platform engineering, including troubleshooting and supporting users

• 
Good communication skills in written and spoken English and an interest in working with different stakeholders

• 
Experience with or knowledge of Azure Landing Zones, Infrastructure as Code, cloud networking, governance, or identity and access management is a plus, but not a requirement

Life at NNE.

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 7 December 2026.

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Maiken Høst Hansen at +45 30 77 45 61.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

Help shape the future of digital manufacturing at BioMar

As BioMar continues to expand the deployment of the BioMar Manufacturing Platform (BMP) and other Manufacturing Digital Transformation (MDT) solutions across our production sites, we are looking for a Digital Transformation Specialist to strengthen our MDT team.

In this role, you will play a key part in bringing digital solutions to life across our global production network. You will work closely with production sites and MDT product teams to ensure successful implementation, adoption, and embedding of new solutions, helping sites realize value while enabling development teams to remain focused on innovation.

Create lasting impact across our global production network

You will act as the link between site operations and MDT product teams, supporting deployments from commissioning through adoption and consolidation. Your work will help ensure that digital solutions are successfully embedded into daily operations and continue to support BioMar’s manufacturing excellence journey.

Success in this role requires a strong manufacturing mindset, the ability to build trust with stakeholders, and a hands-on approach during critical implementation phases. You will work closely with colleagues across functions, cultures, and locations while contributing to meaningful improvements across our production network.

• Support commissioning and deployment of the BioMar Manufacturing Platform (BMP) at production sites.

• Coordinate deployment activities between site stakeholders and MDT product teams while supporting implementation of future MDT applications and digital solutions.

• Deliver user training, facilitate knowledge transfer, and develop deployment, training, and support documentation.

• Provide first-line support during implementation and hyper care periods, including support for testing and user acceptance activities.

• Drive user adoption, collect improvement opportunities from sites, and contribute to the continuous improvement of MDT deployment methodologies and product ownership activities where required.

Bring your manufacturing expertise to drive digital adoption

You combine technical understanding with the ability to work effectively with people across different functions, cultures, and locations. You enjoy supporting operational teams, solving practical challenges, and helping users adopt new ways of working.

You are comfortable engaging with operators, supervisors, engineers, and site leadership teams. You take ownership of your work, build strong relationships, and are motivated by continuous learning and improvement in a global manufacturing environment.

Must-have requirements

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a similar field.

• Approximately 2-5 years of relevant experience within manufacturing, production, operations, continuous improvement, automation, digital transformation, or related areas.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across functions and cultures.

• Pragmatic and solution-oriented approach combined with the ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.

• Willingness to travel internationally and spend significant time at BioMar production sites during deployment and stabilization activities.

Nice-to-have qualifications

Experience with digital manufacturing solutions, MES systems, reporting platforms, process optimization technologies, or similar digital tools will be an advantage. Experience supporting user adoption, training activities, or change management initiatives will also support success in the role. The preferred location for candidates is Europe.

Join a global team shaping meaningful change

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of manufacturing and digital transformation in a truly international environment. You will collaborate with colleagues across BioMar’s global production network and contribute to the successful implementation of solutions that support operational excellence and standardization.

The role offers broad exposure to production environments, digital technologies, and cross-functional collaboration. With approximately 80-90 travel days per year, you will work directly with sites during deployment, commissioning, training, and stabilization phases, creating tangible impact across the business.

Take the next step in your BioMar journey

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information about the position, please contact Óscar Sanz Sevillano, Head of Manufacturing Digital Transformation, at +34 649 90 22 19.

PLEASE NOTE: Our job advertisement is automatically and continuously renewed on job portals until the position is occupied. A renewal of the job advertisement does not indicate reposting, even if it may appear that way.

We look forward to hearing from you and learning more about how your experience and ambitions can contribute to the continued success of our Manufacturing Digital Transformation journey.

More than half of the seafood consumed globally comes from aquaculture. At BioMar, we are committed to developing and delivering efficient, sustainable, and healthy aquaculture feed solutions. Innovation and partnerships are at the heart of everything we do, and we are proud that our highly skilled people share this commitment. With feed factories in 13 countries across 4 continents, we supply feed to over 90 countries, supporting more than 45 different species of fish and shrimp. Join us on our journey to innovate aquaculture.

Fish Technician

Help shape the future of aquaculture through hands-on research support

At BioMar ATC Hirtshals, you will play an important role in supporting R&D trials that contribute to the development of innovative aquaculture solutions. Working close to research activities and fish production systems, you will help ensure that trials are conducted efficiently while maintaining a strong focus on animal wellbeing.

This is a practical and varied role where no two days are exactly the same. You will work alongside colleagues who share a passion for learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement, while contributing directly to research projects that support BioMar's innovation journey.

Make a difference in our research and trial activities

As a Fish Technician, you will contribute to the success of our R&D programmes by providing hands-on support throughout all stages of experimental trials. You will help create an efficient working environment and ensure that fish welfare remains at the forefront of our daily activities.

Working closely with the team, you will support both routine activities and trial-related tasks while contributing to the smooth operation of our recirculated aquaculture systems (RAS).

• Monitor water quality and oxygen levels to help ensure animal wellbeing

• Participate in and support fish sampling procedures

• Assist with the execution of R&D trials

• Support maintenance and daily operation of recirculated aquaculture systems (RAS)

• Collect and maintain trial-related data using Microsoft Excel

Bring your curiosity and passion for aquatic life

You thrive in a hands-on environment and enjoy being part of a team where learning and collaboration are valued. You take responsibility for your tasks and contribute positively to achieving shared goals.

We are looking for someone with a genuine interest in fish and aquaculture who is motivated to support research activities and continuously develop their knowledge and skills.

Must-have requirements

• Interest in fish and aquaculture

• Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel

• Ability to communicate in English at a working level

• Team-oriented approach and willingness to support colleagues

• Curiosity and motivation to learn and improve

Nice-to-have qualifications

• Knowledge of recirculated aquaculture systems (RAS)

• Previous experience working with fish or aquatic environments

• Danish language skills

Join a collaborative environment where your contribution matters

This role offers the opportunity to work directly with research activities that support the development of sustainable aquaculture. You will become part of a team that values curiosity, knowledge sharing, and collaboration, where everyone contributes to achieving common goals. Through hands-on experience with fish husbandry, RAS operations, sampling activities, and data collection, you will gain valuable insight into aquaculture research and innovation while helping shape solutions for the future of the industry.

Practical information

Workplace: BioMar, Niels Juelsvej 38, 9850 Hirtshals

Application deadline: December 19th. We encourage interested candidates to apply and look forward to hearing from you.

Take the next step in your aquaculture career

If you would like to learn more about the role, please contact Clément Crouzet on mobile: +45 27 15 11 59.  Applications should be submitted by clicking   APPLY.

About BioMar

More than half of the seafood consumed globally comes from aquaculture. At BioMar, we are committed to developing and delivering efficient, sustainable, and healthy aquaculture feed solutions. **Help us bring AI from ambition to reality

**At AGC Biologics, we have reached an exciting point in our AI journey. The governance foundation is in place, several high-value use cases have been identified, and we are now ready to scale the development and deployment of AI solutions across the business.

To support this journey, we are looking for an AI & Data Solutions Engineer who can help turn business challenges into practical and scalable AI solutions.

This role sits within our Global Data, AI & Business Platforms organization and will work at the intersection of business, technology, and innovation. You will collaborate with stakeholders across AGC Biologics, partner with AGC Inc.'s Data Science teams, and contribute directly to the design, development, and deployment of AI-powered solutions that support manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and business operations.

**What You'll Be Doing

**In your first months, you will be involved in several AI initiatives already identified across the organization. Some solutions will be developed together with AGC Inc.'s Data Science teams, while others will be built and deployed directly within AGC Biologics.

Success in this role requires someone who enjoys moving between business discussions and technical implementation. One day you may be meeting with stakeholders to understand a new AI opportunity and define requirements. The next, you may be preparing datasets, working on solution architecture, developing machine learning capabilities, or supporting the deployment of an AI solution into production.

You will work closely with our Data Engineering, Analytics, Solution Architecture, and Digitalization teams and play an important role in ensuring that AI solutions are technically robust, business-relevant, and ready for real-world use.

**What We're Looking For

**We imagine you come from a background in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related field, and have already worked hands-on with building, deploying, or supporting AI and data-driven solutions.

You are comfortable working with technologies such as Python, SQL, Azure, and ideally have exposure to platforms such as Microsoft Fabric and Snowflake. Experience working with machine learning models, AI applications, data pipelines, and data preparation is important, while familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, or other emerging AI technologies would be a significant advantage.

Equally important is your ability to work with people. This is a highly business-facing role, and we are looking for someone who can confidently engage stakeholders, translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate complex concepts in a simple and understandable way.

You enjoy collaboration, challenge assumptions constructively, and thrive in environments where priorities evolve and new opportunities emerge.

**Experience That Will Help You Succeed

**Experience from the pharmaceutical, biotech, or other GxP-regulated industries will be considered a strong advantage. We also welcome candidates coming from manufacturing or production-focused environments where technology, data, and business operations come together to support critical processes.

Whether your background is in AI Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, or Data Engineering, what matters most is your ability to combine technical expertise with strong stakeholder engagement and a genuine passion for solving business problems through technology.

**Why AGC Biologics?

**This is an opportunity to join a growing global team where AI is becoming a strategic capability across the organization. You will have the chance to influence how AI is adopted, work with modern technologies, collaborate with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and North America, and contribute to solutions that support the development and manufacturing of therapies that improve patients' lives around the world.

If you are excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of AI at AGC Biologics, we would love to hear from you.

**Interested in Joining Us?

**If you are interested we would like to hear from you.

Applications are screened on an ongoing basis. You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences in you CV about your motivation for applying to this position.

Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark, or the greater Malmø area.

If this sounds like the right challenge for you, we’d love to hear from you. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you don’t meet every single requirement. The right mindset matters just as much.

Please submit your application through the AGC Biologics careers site. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

**Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help shape the next generation of development at Dalux.

**Dalux is growing, and we are looking for experienced software developers who want significant technical ownership while continuing to build software hands-on.

You will work on products used by professionals around the world, contribute to architectural and technical decisions, and help us improve how we develop software – including how we use agentic AI to make capable developers more effective.

**Your role

**As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will work in a product team with other developers, a Product Manager, and a Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks by making good technical decisions, improving our architecture and development practices, and sharing knowledge with others.

Your work can include:

• Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end

• Designing scalable, maintainable solutions and contributing to architectural decisions

• Improving our codebase, tooling, developer workflows, and technical quality

• Driving or contributing to initiatives around DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure, architecture, or developer tooling

• Sparring with and mentoring other developers

• Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions

• Bringing new ideas and technologies into Dalux when they can improve our products or how we build them

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

**Developing software with agentic AI

**We are significantly increasing our use of agentic AI in software development.

We use and explore AI across the development lifecycle – from understanding problems and navigating codebases to implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and review.

We are looking for developers who already use agentic AI as part of their development workflow. The specific tools matter less than how you use them: providing the right context and direction, critically evaluating the output, and knowing when to intervene or take a different approach.

Strong engineering fundamentals remain essential. AI can increase what a capable developer can achieve, but you remain responsible for the architecture, correctness, maintainability, and quality of the software you build.

At Dalux, you will help us take these ways of working further by experimenting, sharing what works, and helping establish effective practices for agentic software development.

**Technologies we work with

**Our platform is built on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS. Our primary technologies include:

• C# / .NET

• Angular / TypeScript

• GitHub Copilot

• MSSQL

• Elasticsearch

• AWS

• Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You may also encounter parts of our C++ codebase.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

**Product development at Dalux

**Our developers do more than implement specifications.

Developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers work together to understand problems and find solutions that balance user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

**Your background

**We expect that you:

• Have solid professional software development experience

• Have at least six months of practical experience using agentic AI as part of your software development workflow

• Hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related technical field

• Have strong software engineering fundamentals

• Are comfortable owning complex technical problems and decisions

• Can navigate and improve an established codebase and architecture

• Care about maintainability, reliability, performance, and quality

• Enjoy technical sparring and sharing knowledge with other developers

• Understand the trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term technical quality

Experience with C#/.NET, Angular, or cloud development is useful, but we do not expect you to match every technology we use.

**What You Can Expect From Dalux

**Dalux is a software company at heart. As an experienced developer, you can expect:

• Significant ownership and real influence on technical solutions

• Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge

• Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design

• Short paths from ideas to decisions and implementation

• Opportunities to improve engineering practices beyond your immediate product work

• An environment actively investing in agentic AI for software development

• High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

**About Dalux

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, we develop software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

**Interested?

**If you want significant technical ownership while helping shape how modern software is developed at Dalux, we would like to hear from you.

**If agentic AI is already part of how you develop software, tell us how you use it – what you delegate, how you validate the result, and where you have found it genuinely useful.

**We recruit continuously and hire multiple experienced developers throughout the year as Dalux grows.

If you have questions about the position, contact IT Talent Acquisition Specialist Sara Nielsen on SNI@dalux.com

**Application deadline:

**Ongoing

Are you passionate about IT Infrastructure and ready to take ownership of our core infrastructure environment? Join Dalux in Copenhagen, if you don´t want to miss out on a great growth journey with impact opportunities.

**Your new role

**As an experienced IT infrastructure engineer, you will take ownership of our core infrastructure environment, which includes a mix of on-premise and cloud-based systems. You’ll play a key role in ensuring our systems remain secure, scalable, and resilient as the company continues to grow.

**What You'll Do

**

• Maintain and improve our hybrid infrastructure (Windows and Linux servers, Virtualization, AD, file services, containerization).

• Manage Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and related cloud services.

• Ensure secure network operations (firewalls, VPN, VLANs, DNS filtering).

• Manage backup and disaster recovery systems and processes.

• Support identity and access management with a strong security focus.

• Document infrastructure, configurations, and processes clearly and consistently.

• Perform routine system updates, patching, and preventative maintenance.

• Monitor systems and respond to performance or availability issues.

• Work closely with Security team on shared initiatives.

• Contribute to IT projects including hardware lifecycle, network upgrades, and automation.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Strong experience in IT infrastructure roles (ideally 5+ years).

• Experience with Microsoft technologies (AD, Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Entra, Intune).

• Knowledge of networking (Layer 2/3, VLANs, firewalls, DNS, DHCP, VPN).

• Comfortable with scripting or automation tools (PowerShell preferred).

• A pragmatic, security-conscious mindset.

**What To Expect As a Daluxian

**You will become part of a highly skilled organization of passionate individuals. Everyday life is characterized by sparring between colleagues, room to be yourself, with monthly social events and various clubs.

The well-being of our people is important for us, and we take a harmonious work-life balance seriously. Long weeks and overtime are not something we make use of. We would much rather see you invest your extra energy into our social events and clubs, if you want to.

You will find Daluxians in 30 countries and we have 60+ offices at the moment with our head office at Vibenhuset in Copenhagen.

**Ready for the next step

**If Dalux sounds like a place for you, we would gladly accept your application. We will be having ongoing interviews.

**What is Dalux?

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Ph.D. Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard. Dalux’ products are aimed at making construction, which are the second biggest and least digitalized industry, become more effective.

Our user-friendly digital tools and Building Information Modelling-technology (also known as BIM) are used in more than 140 countries globally. We are crazy about cool technology and have experience being first movers on new tech. Our products are based on our unique 3D BIM technology and makes use of AR - all developed entirely by Dalux.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

**Please note: Applicants must already be based in Copenhagen and be authorised to work in Denmark.

****The role

****Responsibilities

**You will work across the full stack on Aiomic360, from the database model and API to the interface nurses use every day. Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing the nurses’ interface in React and TypeScript. The forms are data-driven: protocol files define the fields, answer options and rules for when a field is relevant.

• Building and maintaining our REST API using Django and Django REST Framework, with PostgreSQL as the database.

• Making AI suggestions easy to verify, so nurses can quickly see the source behind an answer and approve or correct it.

• Improving the data pipelines that ingest patient record data and process it using language models on Azure.

• Ensuring that exports to registry XML formats remain accurate as protocols change from year to year.

• Keeping the system fast and reliable, even when handling large numbers of cases and lengthy patient records.

• Ensuring that health data is handled securely.

**You’ll work with

**React 19

• TypeScript

• Redux Toolkit

• Vite

• Python

• Django

• PostgreSQL

• Azure

• LLMs

**About You

**

• You have experience building web applications that run in production.

• You are strong in React and TypeScript and have worked with Python on the backend, ideally with Django.

• You are comfortable working with relational databases and designing APIs.

• You write tests as a natural part of your work. We use Vitest, React Testing Library and Playwright on the frontend, and Django’s testing tools on the backend.

• You are curious about how users work and ask questions until you understand what they need.

• You speak and write English confidently. We work with international customers, and our code and documentation are in English.

**It Is a Plus If You Have Experience With

**

• Microsoft Azure, for example Azure Functions, Azure Machine Learning or Application Insights.

• Language models in production, including prompt development, evaluation and error analysis.

• Health data, such as electronic health records, FHIR or clinical quality registries.

• Redux Toolkit or Chakra UI.

• Sign-in with Microsoft Entra ID via MSAL.

**AI development tools are a regular part of our work, including coding assistants and agents that can write and review code, tests and documentation. You do not need previous experience with these tools, but we expect you to use them and stay curious about how they can improve your work. You remain responsible for the code you deliver, and it is reviewed in the same way as any other code.

**What We Offer

**

• The chance to work on a product with a clear purpose: better quality data helps hospitals improve care and prevent complications.

• A full-stack role where you can see your work being used by clinicians.

• The opportunity to help bring Aiomic360 to hospitals in Denmark.
